# w21 rel-newseeds — TABLES (generated by scripts/w21_relnew_tables.py)

⛔ CMAZE-T only. No PREREG, no bar, no label, no verdict: every arm, seed and row is printed; the Head decides what is quotable.

**Caption (every table):** CMAZE-T, condition BOTH (words-plus-observation), TEST leg. Six seeds (0-5), all run, all printed, none discarded. CLU-REL-A10 = the peer's frozen config (sha256 0d4ec5b9…, K 2, 10 atoms, ridge 1, 9,200 read floats); A1 = latent 128, K 2, 6 atoms, ridge 1 (4,584 read floats). Rivals are re-matched to each config's own read-path floats by the standing rule and trained by the frozen 8k / 80k recipe. Seed count is a column on every table.

Easy/hard labels are maze-t-seed4's (largest gap in A1's BOTH TEST per-seed ceilings; `C:/chlu/outputs/w21-maze-t-seed4\MAZE-T-SEED4.json`), carried over UNCHANGED so the two configs are read with the same column split; the same rule applied to CLU-REL-A10's own ceilings is printed in §1.

## 0. Six-seed side-by-side, n-way row (exact) — both configs, same rows, same arms, same ceiling definition

Ceiling = best n-way over every arm FITTED TO THE TRAIN DATA (`w21_tables.CEIL_PREFIX`: CLU, matched rivals 8k and 80k, 10x-read-floats diagnostic, controls, learned blind arms, lookup floors) — the definition used for A1 in maze-t-seed4. Planner columns (GIVEN the engine rules; ORACLE = 1.000 by construction) are EXCLUDED and printed beside. The `+rel` diagnostic arms exist only in CLU-REL-A10 runs and are NOT in that ceiling; a second CLU-REL-A10 ceiling that includes them is printed as its own row.

## 2. ⭐⭐ The `+rel` DIAGNOSTIC — rivals handed the CLU's relational columns, per seed and row (CLU-REL-A10 runs only)

`+rel` = a copy of each rival's shared input (obs ⊕ 318 design) with CLU-REL-A10's colour-relational columns appended (`w21_clu.CluFactory.relations_block`), re-matched to the same read floats, frozen recipe at 8k and 80k. A DIAGNOSTIC, never a rival row and never a label: it separates the CODING (the relational columns) from the STORE.
